profile_text.body:
Beamery is a London-based company founded in 2012 that describes itself as an AI-powered Workforce Transformation Platform. According to its site, the platform is aimed at aligning talent strategy, supporting development, and improving workforce planning, with a Workforce Intelligence Suite for modeling future scenarios, uncovering talent risks, and balancing automation, reskilling, and hiring. Its listed capabilities include sourcing and matching, a talent CRM, talent marketing, talent analytics, skills intelligence, job design and calibration, career sites and a chatbot, along with advisory, implementation, and enablement services.

The company's AI position centers on an embedded agentic AI consultant called Ray, which Beamery says is built on ethical AI models and provides context-aware recommendations. The site also describes AI-powered sourcing, matching, and engagement integrated into existing HR systems, and unified skills data applied to hiring, upskilling, and retention. Beamery names Flex, which used its AI to turn unstructured data such as job descriptions into a customized skills framework, and Salesforce, which it says improved hire quality and reduced data quality risks through an integrated Talent CRM with real-time talent recommendations. The site also cites high compliance standards and lists a trust center, privacy and cookie policies, and a bug bounty program.

The product record describes Beamery as talent lifecycle management AI with a skills ontology and DEI analytics, hosted in the UK and relevant to GDPR. No litigation or MCP server information is recorded.
